name: recruitcrm-mcp-server
description: Search candidates & jobs, analyze hiring pipelines, manage tasks & hotlists, and run your full recruiting workflow from any AI tool.
long_description: Connect your Recruit CRM account to Claude and other AI tools. Search and update candidates, jobs, companies, and contacts. Dig into notes, tasks, meetings, call logs, and hiring stage history. Build and manage hotlists, analyze pipeline bottlenecks and idle candidates with detailed time-to-hire metrics, work with custom fields and their nested dependencies, and get up to speed before any candidate or client interaction.

api_token.title: Recruit CRM API Token
api_token.description: Your Recruit CRM API token (found in Admin Settings → API)

tools.name: search_candidates
tools.description: Search candidates with filters and return compact summaries. Filter by owner_id to scope results to a specific user; resolve user IDs with list_users. Opt-in include_contact_info flag adds email, contact_number, and linkedin to results.

tools.name: list_candidates
tools.description: List all candidates with pagination and sorting only. Use search_candidates for filtered queries. Opt-in include_contact_info flag adds email, contact_number, and linkedin to results.

tools.name: create_candidate
tools.description: Create one candidate, then optionally add up to 10 work history rows and up to 10 education history rows. Requires first_name or last_name, owner_id, and created_by. Resolve currency_id with list_currencies and language_skills with list_languages_and_proficiencies. Checks duplicates by email, contact_number, or linkedin unless allow_duplicate=true; duplicate errors include candidate_slug and candidate_id when available. Returns a compact summary with candidate slug and partial-success details for history operations.

tools.name: update_candidate
tools.description: Update one existing candidate by candidate_slug, then optionally add up to 10 work history rows and up to 10 education history rows. Requires candidate_slug, updated_by, and first_name or last_name. Resolve currency_id with list_currencies and language_skills with list_languages_and_proficiencies. Returns a compact summary with candidate slug and partial-success details for history operations.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search jobs with filters and return compact summaries. Filter by owner_id to scope results to a specific user; resolve user IDs with list_users. Returns hiring_pipeline_id for job-specific stage lookup with list_candidate_hiring_stages. Supports custom_fields filters; resolve field ids with list_custom_fields.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List all jobs with pagination and sorting only. Use search_jobs for filtered queries.

tools.name: create_job
tools.description: Create one Recruit CRM job. Requires name, company_slug, contact_slug, enable_job_application_form, owner_id, and created_by. job_description_text and currency_id are optional per live API verification. Sends application/json to POST /v1/jobs. Defaults enable_auto_populate_teams to true and show_company_logo to 2. Resolve users with list_users, companies with search_companies or list_companies, contacts with search_contacts or list_contacts, statuses with list_job_statuses, currencies with list_currencies, qualifications with list_qualifications, teams with list_teams, candidate questions with list_candidate_questions, XML job boards with list_xml_jobboards, hiring pipelines with list_hiring_pipelines, and custom fields with list_custom_fields.

tools.name: update_job
tools.description: Update one existing Recruit CRM job by job_slug. Requires job_slug, updated_by, and at least one field to update. Resolve currencies with list_currencies, qualifications with list_qualifications, teams with list_teams, candidate questions with list_candidate_questions, XML job boards with list_xml_jobboards, and hiring pipelines with list_hiring_pipelines. Sends application/json to POST /v1/jobs/{job}. Returns a compact summary with job slug and app link.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search companies with filters and return compact summaries. Filter by owner_id to scope results to a specific user; resolve user IDs with list_users. Supports custom_fields filters; resolve field ids with list_custom_fields.

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: List all companies with pagination and sorting only. Use search_companies for filtered queries.

tools.name: create_company
tools.description: Create one company. Requires company_name, owner_id, and created_by. Checks duplicates by company_name unless allow_duplicate=true. Resolve user IDs with list_users and custom field IDs with list_custom_fields for companies. Returns a compact summary with company slug.

tools.name: update_company
tools.description: Update one existing company by company_slug. Requires company_slug and updated_by. Resolve user IDs with list_users and custom field IDs with list_custom_fields for companies. Returns a compact summary with company slug.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Search contacts with filters and return compact summaries. Filter by owner_id to scope results to a specific user; resolve user IDs with list_users. Requires at least one real filter; sort/page/exact_search alone do not count. Supports custom_fields filters (counts as a real filter); resolve field ids with list_custom_fields. Opt-in include_contact_info adds email, contact_number, and linkedin.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List all contacts with pagination and sorting only. Use search_contacts for filtered queries. Opt-in include_contact_info adds email, contact_number, and linkedin.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Create one contact. Requires first_name, last_name, owner_id, and created_by. Checks duplicates by email, contact_number, or linkedin unless allow_duplicate=true. Resolve stage_id with list_contact_stages and custom field IDs with list_custom_fields for contacts. Returns a compact summary with contact slug.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Update one existing contact by contact_slug. Requires contact_slug and updated_by. Resolve stage_id with list_contact_stages and custom field IDs with list_custom_fields for contacts. Returns a compact summary with contact slug.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List Recruit CRM users with compact id, first_name, last_name, and status fields. Opt-in include_teams adds team memberships; opt-in include_contact_info adds email and contact_number.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List Recruit CRM teams with MCP-side pagination. By default returns team IDs, names, and user IDs. Pass expand=user to return user summaries; include_user_contact_info=true adds user email, contact_number, and avatar.

tools.name: list_candidate_questions
tools.description: List Recruit CRM candidate questions with MCP-side pagination. Returns compact id and question rows.

tools.name: list_hiring_pipelines
tools.description: List Recruit CRM hiring pipelines with MCP-side pagination. Returns hiring_pipeline_id and name rows.

tools.name: list_languages_and_proficiencies
tools.description: List Recruit CRM languages with MCP-side pagination and return standard proficiency IDs for candidate language_skills.

tools.name: list_currencies
tools.description: List Recruit CRM currencies with MCP-side pagination. Resolves currency_id for candidate and job tools.

tools.name: list_qualifications
tools.description: List Recruit CRM qualifications with MCP-side pagination. Resolves qualification_id for job tools.

tools.name: list_xml_jobboards
tools.description: List Recruit CRM XML job boards for jobs. Returns default_xml_feeds and custom_xml_feeds rows with id and label.

tools.name: search_hotlists
tools.description: Search hotlists by required related_to_type and optional name/shared filters. Does not support owner filtering. Broad searches return related_count only; name-targeted searches also include related_slugs.

tools.name: create_hotlist
tools.description: Create one hotlist. Requires name, related_to_type, shared flag (0 private, 1 team-shared), and created_by user id. Resolve user IDs with list_users.

tools.name: add_records_to_hotlist
tools.description: Add up to 10 record slugs to an existing hotlist. Duplicate input slugs are ignored. Returns partial-success details with added_slugs and an errors array for any failed additions.

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.description: Search tasks and return compact summaries with related entity context. Filter by owner_id to scope results to a specific user; resolve user IDs with list_users.

tools.name: list_task_types
tools.description: List task types with id and label. Use task_type_id in create_task.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create one Recruit CRM task. Requires task_type_id, title, description, reminder, start_date, owner_id, and created_by. Resolve task type IDs with list_task_types and user IDs with list_users. Description supports basic HTML/rich text. Associated slug and collaborator arrays are capped at 25 items each. Returns a compact task summary.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update one existing Recruit CRM task by task_id. Requires task_id, updated_by, and at least one field to update. Resolve task type IDs with list_task_types and user IDs with list_users. Returns a compact task summary.

tools.name: search_meetings
tools.description: Search meetings and return compact summaries with scheduling metadata. Filter by owner_id to scope results to a specific user; resolve user IDs with list_users.

tools.name: list_meeting_types
tools.description: List meeting types with id and label. Use meeting_type_id in create_meeting.

tools.name: create_meeting
tools.description: Create one Recruit CRM meeting. Requires title, reminder, start_date, end_date, owner_id, and created_by. Resolve meeting type IDs with list_meeting_types and user IDs with list_users. Calendar invites are not sent by default; set do_not_send_calendar_invites to false to send external calendar invites to attendees. Attendee, associated slug, and collaborator arrays are capped at 25 items each. Returns a compact meeting summary.

tools.name: update_meeting
tools.description: Update one existing Recruit CRM meeting by meeting_id. Requires meeting_id, updated_by, and at least one field to update. Resolve meeting type IDs with list_meeting_types and user IDs with list_users. Calendar invites are not sent by default; set do_not_send_calendar_invites to false to send external calendar invites to attendees. Returns a compact meeting summary.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search notes and return compact summaries with related entity context. Does not support owner filtering.

tools.name: list_note_types
tools.description: List note types with id and label. Use note_type_id in create_note.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create one Recruit CRM note. Requires note_type_id, description, related_to, related_to_type, and created_by user id. Resolve note type IDs with list_note_types and user IDs with list_users. Description supports basic HTML/rich text. Associated slug and collaborator arrays are capped at 25 items each. Returns a compact note summary.

tools.name: update_note
tools.description: Update one existing Recruit CRM note by note_id. Requires note_id, updated_by, and at least one field to update. Resolve note type IDs with list_note_types and user IDs with list_users. Returns a compact note summary.

tools.name: search_call_logs
tools.description: Search call logs and return compact summaries with related entity context. Does not support owner filtering.

tools.name: list_call_types
tools.description: List custom call types with id and label. Use custom_call_type_id in create_call_log.

tools.name: create_call_log
tools.description: Create one Recruit CRM call log. Requires call_type, custom_call_type_id, call_started_on, related_to_type, created_by, and updated_by. Resolve call type IDs with list_call_types and user IDs with list_users. related_to_type must be candidate, contact, or company. Associated slug and collaborator arrays are capped at 25 items each. Returns a compact call log summary.

tools.name: update_call_log
tools.description: Update one existing Recruit CRM call log by call_log_id. Requires call_log_id, updated_by, and at least one field to update. Resolve call type IDs with list_call_types and user IDs with list_users. related_to_type must be candidate, contact, or company. Returns a compact call log summary.

tools.name: get_candidate_details
tools.description: Fetch full details for up to 10 candidates by slug in parallel. Suitable for retrieving specific candidate records after slug resolution from search_candidates. Returns partial results with a separate errors array for failed slugs.

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description: Fetch full details for up to 10 jobs by slug in parallel. Returns partial results with a separate errors array for failed slugs. Job objects preserve the full Recruit CRM payload.

tools.name: get_company_details
tools.description: Fetch full details for up to 10 companies by slug in parallel. Returns partial results with a separate errors array for failed slugs.

tools.name: get_contact_details
tools.description: Fetch full details for up to 10 contacts by slug in parallel. Returns partial results with a separate errors array for failed slugs.

tools.name: get_job_assigned_candidates
tools.description: Fetch candidates assigned to a job with compact assignment summaries. Filter by status_id to narrow to a specific hiring stage; resolve stage IDs with list_candidate_hiring_stages.

tools.name: list_candidate_hiring_stages
tools.description: List candidate hiring stage labels and ids. Pass hiring_pipeline_id 0 for the Master Hiring Pipeline; use the hiring_pipeline_id from search_jobs or list_jobs for job-specific stages.

tools.name: list_pitch_stages
tools.description: List Recruit CRM pitch pipeline stages with status_id and label values for resolving pitch stage names.

tools.name: pitch_candidate_to_contact
tools.description: Mark one Recruit CRM candidate as pitched to one contact. Requires candidate_slug, contact_slug, and created_by. Checks existing candidate/contact pitch records unless allow_duplicate=true. Records the pitch in Recruit CRM; the API does not send email.

tools.name: update_candidate_pitch_stage
tools.description: Update the pitch stage for one candidate/contact pitch record. Requires candidate_slug, contact_slug, status_id, stage_date, and updated_by. Resolve status_id with list_pitch_stages; remark is optional text.

tools.name: get_pitch_history
tools.description: Fetch pitch history for one Recruit CRM candidate or contact by slug using entity_type candidate or contact. Returns compact pitch entries with updated_by, without created_by, email, phone, resume, or profile image fields.

tools.name: get_pitched_records
tools.description: Fetch contacts where a candidate is pitched or candidates pitched to a contact. Set entity_type to candidate or contact. Returns compact records without email, phone, resume, or profile image fields.

tools.name: assign_candidate_to_job
tools.description: Assigns one Recruit CRM candidate to one job at the default Assigned hiring stage. Requires candidate_slug, job_slug, and updated_by. Does not support remarks, explicit stage selection, stage_date, or create_placement; use update_candidate_hiring_stage afterward when a non-default stage or remark is needed.

tools.name: update_candidate_hiring_stage
tools.description: Updates one candidate's hiring stage for a specific Recruit CRM job. Requires candidate_slug, job_slug, status_id, stage_date, and updated_by. By default this only changes the hiring stage. When create_placement=true, Recruit CRM also creates a placement record in the dedicated placements section. Resolve status_id with list_candidate_hiring_stages. remark supports basic HTML/rich text.

tools.name: list_job_statuses
tools.description: List job pipeline statuses (Open, Closed, On Hold, plus any custom labels) with id and label for resolving status names to the numeric job_status_id used by search_jobs.job_status.

tools.name: list_contact_stages
tools.description: List Recruit CRM contact sales pipeline stages with stage_id and label values for resolving contact stage names.

tools.name: list_off_limit_statuses
tools.description: List account off-limit statuses with id, label, sequence_no, and default for resolving status_id values.

tools.name: mark_candidate_off_limit
tools.description: Mark up to 25 Recruit CRM candidates as off-limit. Requires candidate_slugs, status_id, and end_date in DD-MM-YYYY format; reason is optional.

tools.name: mark_contact_off_limit
tools.description: Mark up to 25 Recruit CRM contacts as off-limit. Requires contact_slugs, status_id, and end_date in DD-MM-YYYY format; reason is optional.

tools.name: mark_company_off_limit
tools.description: Mark up to 25 Recruit CRM companies as off-limit. Requires company_slugs, status_id, end_date in DD-MM-YYYY format, mark_contact_off_limit, and mark_candidate_off_limit; reason is optional.

tools.name: mark_records_available
tools.description: Mark up to 25 Recruit CRM candidates, contacts, or companies as available, removing their off-limit state. Requires record_type and slugs; companies also require mark_contact_available and mark_candidate_available for related-record availability updates.

tools.name: get_candidate_job_assignment_hiring_stage_history
tools.description: Fetch a candidate's job assignment hiring stage history by candidate slug. Returns compact entries with job, company, stage, remark, and update metadata.

tools.name: list_custom_fields
tools.description: List custom field metadata for a specific entity type (candidates, contacts, companies, jobs, deals). Searchable fields only by default; set include_non_searchable=true to also include file, user, company, and other non-searchable field types.

tools.name: get_custom_field_details
tools.description: Fetch curated details for one custom field by field_id and entity_type (candidates, contacts, companies, jobs, deals), including full dropdown or multiselect options.

tools.name: get_custom_field_dependencies
tools.description: Get parent-child dependency relationships for custom fields of a given entity type (candidates, contacts, companies, jobs, deals). Optionally narrow to a specific field's dependency subtree via field_id. When setting a child custom field, the parent field_id and its value must also be included in the custom_fields array.

tools.name: prepare_client_brief
tools.description: Prepares a client/account briefing for recruiters before a client call, client meeting, hiring-manager check-in, account review, business-development outreach, or client follow-up. Produces talking points, account health, open jobs, primary and secondary client contacts, assigned-candidate pipeline status, client-feedback blockers, candidates waiting on feedback, recent notes / meetings / tasks / call logs, pitched candidates for the contact, relationship risks, and recommended follow-ups. Inputs are exact Recruit CRM contact_slug or company_slug; display names are not accepted as slug values. Returns summaries and recommended follow-ups only.

tools.name: analyze_job_pipeline
tools.description: Diagnose a single job's hiring pipeline: stage distribution, days-in-current-stage, idle candidates, bottleneck verdict, recent notes/meetings/tasks, and suggested next actions. Set include_time_metrics=true for time-to-hire and time-to-stage data (extra API calls; default false). Requires job_slug; resolve from search_jobs if only a job name is available.
